nodes.label: Custom-Marker fuer unbekannte Werte
nodes.rationale: Unbekannte Werte werden trotzdem gespeichert, nur ohne Erklaerung und Kategorie — ein fehlender Katalogtreffer blockiert nichts.

nodes.label: Effektive Referenz-Aufloesung
nodes.rationale: Labor-Referenz am Eintrag hat Vorrang, danach der Katalog-Standard, sonst 'kein Referenzbereich' — eine Regel, an allen Anzeigeorten identisch.

nodes.label: Hochgeladene Datei wird nicht gespeichert
nodes.rationale: Datenschutz und keine Storage-Kosten; die Datei dient ausschliesslich der Extraktion.

nodes.label: Rate-Limit 10 Importe pro Monat
nodes.rationale: Kostenkontrolle ohne Extra-Tabelle: gezaehlt wird ueber bloodwork_reports mit source='import' der letzten 30 Tage; Premium-Gating bleibt vorerst aus.

nodes.label: Duplikat-Fingerprint
nodes.rationale: Aus Inhaltsstoffen, Form und Staerke wird ein normalisierter Vergleichsschluessel gebildet; es gibt bewusst keine harte Datenbank-Eindeutigkeit, weil reale parallele Varianten erlaubt bleiben muessen.

nodes.label: Wiederverwendung bereits geladener Zyklen
nodes.rationale: Die Detailansicht nutzt die von My Stack bereits geladenen Zyklen; keine neue Abfrage, kein Schema-Feld, keine Route und keine neue Abhaengigkeit.

nodes.label: Reduzierte Bewegung ohne Glow
nodes.rationale: Bei prefers-reduced-motion erscheinen alle Karten sofort; Bewegung nutzt nur transform und opacity, damit kein Layout-Sprung und keine Verzoegerung der Chart-Navigation entsteht.

nodes.label: Client-seitiges Template-Rendering
nodes.rationale: Templates sind deterministisch, deshalb rendert der Browser die Vorschau und exportiert sie bei Freigabe per Canvas als PNG; Vorschau ist das Endprodukt und kein Rendering-Server noetig.

nodes.label: Compliance-Guardrails der Peptid-Nische
nodes.rationale: Keine Heilversprechen, keine Dosierungsempfehlungen, keine medizinischen Claims; im Prompt verankert und zusaetzlich als Validierungsschicht mit Tests abgesichert.

nodes.label: Eigenes Supabase-Projekt fuer das Studio
nodes.rationale: Marketing-Tooling bleibt von Produktions-Nutzerdaten getrennt, keine RLS-Verflechtung.

nodes.label: Ein Claude-Call pro Thema x Sprache
nodes.norm_label: ein claude-call pro thema x sprache
nodes.rationale: Ein Call liefert alle Kanalvarianten als strukturiertes JSON; ein 5-Themen-Batch in DE+EN kostet damit nur zehn Calls im Cent-Bereich.

nodes.label: pg_cron Auto-Batch mit Zeitplanpruefung
nodes.rationale: pg_cron feuert in festem Takt und die Function prueft den Zeitplan aus settings, damit Zeitplan-Aenderungen sofort wirken ohne Cron-Job neu zu registrieren.

nodes.label: i18n-Vertrag (src/features/my-stack/lib/i18n.test.ts)
nodes.rationale: The contract test requires every key in every language, which is why incomplete-but-unpolished locale files are kept rather than deleted.

nodes.label: data-tracking-card (test hook)
nodes.rationale: Introduced so the test pins structure rather than wording: a test used to assert the code fallback text — text nobody ever sees. Fallbacks are now word-identical with the German locale, and wording is free to change in the language files.

nodes.label: dosePlanCapabilities
nodes.rationale: Derived from `quantity` and `titration` in the capability table; a test asserts it agrees with the table.

nodes.label: InventoryDraft.enabled (inventory's own switch)
nodes.rationale: The single criterion for inventory, valid on every level. Someone who only ticks intake still wants to know when the pack runs out, and should not have to pick 'Vollständig' and enter product strengths that do not interest them. Lowering the level no longer discards pack data — pinned by a test, because it used to be exactly the other way round.

nodes.label: pk_requirement_complete_tracking (i18n key)
nodes.rationale: Names the level by name inside the blood-level simulation, so it had to change with the rename.

nodes.label: TrackingCapabilities
nodes.rationale: No longer carries `inventory`: how precisely someone measures and whether they keep stock are two independent questions, so they must not share an axis.

nodes.label: trackingDepth.ts (capability table)
nodes.rationale: Made the single place where a level is linked to a capability, because the same rule previously lived in four places (table, dosePlan, stackInventory, wizardState) and a divergence between them would never be noticed.

nodes.label: wizardSteps
nodes.rationale: Derives from the `productStrength` capability: whoever has it gets the `ingredients` and `strength` steps. With `details` dropped, the top level has seven instead of eight steps, the two light levels stay at five.

nodes.label: graphify Knowledge Graph Workflow
nodes.rationale: Codebase questions go through `graphify query/path/explain` first because a scoped subgraph is usually much smaller than GRAPH_REPORT.md or raw grep output; `graphify update .` after code changes is AST-only and costs no API calls.

nodes.label: PK-Kurve / Blutspiegel-Simulation
nodes.rationale: Only possible once the active ingredient per unit is known — that is the argument the third card makes for going deeper.

nodes.label: Abschnitt "Produkt & Bestand" im Plan-Schritt
nodes.rationale: For inventory to be reachable on every level it must live in a step every level has — the dose plan step. It also fits in content: what is consumed stands directly above. The section stays collapsed as before.

nodes.label: Produktstärke je Einheit (productStrength capability)
nodes.rationale: The single datum separating the second and third level; wizardSteps derives `ingredients` and `strength` from it, and the blood-level curve depends on it.

nodes.label: Schritt "details" (removed wizard step)
nodes.rationale: Dropped: it was a leftover heap of brand, inventory and notes under a name that names nothing; both contents now live in the plan step.

nodes.label: Segmentreihe mit Ergebnis-Vorschau
nodes.rationale: Replaces three cards with one row of three segments (little on the left, much on the right — the gradation is spatial) over an area showing the result: the entry as it will later stand in the stack. Six findings drove it: the step was too heavy for a reversible, low-risk decision (~650 px, three essays); three equally heavy boxes did not lead the eye; the radio button was redundant next to a fully clickable, glowing card and pushed content 50 px right; the icons (calendar, speedometer, chart) added nothing the words did not; the gradation was asserted, not shown (a stack is not a scale); and the app elsewhere shows things (stage shapes, preview above the form, colour swatch) while this step delivered only prose. Two states are both useful: before choosing, all three entries are compared so the difference is seen rather than read; after choosing, only the chosen entry plus the one sentence on what it additionally records — an empty box saying 'pick something' would have explained nothing. Measured: 650 px → 288–331 px, about half.

nodes.label: Unsichtbare echte Radios (sr-only)
nodes.rationale: Keeps keyboard and screen reader on the same radiogroup as before while the visual layer becomes a scale — accessibility is preserved by hiding, not by removing, the control.

nodes.label: Stufe "Mit Menge" (with quantity)
nodes.rationale: Adjective 'Genau' / EN 'Precise'. Adds how much was taken, which makes the course of the dose analysable. Unlocks quantity and titration.

nodes.label: Stufe "Mit Wirkstärke" / "With strength" (stored value: complete)
nodes.rationale: Renamed from 'Vollständig', which named no effect — it only said 'much', while the other two say what is recorded. The actual difference is exactly one datum: active ingredient per unit, from which the PK curve is computed. Only the label changed; the stored value stays `complete`, because a data migration cannot be justified for a name.

nodes.label: Stufe "Nur Einnahme" (intake_only)
nodes.rationale: Adjective 'Einfach' / EN 'Simple'. Card text: you tick that you took X, nothing more is asked. It deliberately has no preview detail line — that absence is its statement.

nodes.label: Tracking-Stufen (Tracking Levels)
nodes.rationale: Three levels let a user choose how much of their own life they log; the redesign keeps that choice reversible and low-risk, so it must not be presented as a heavy, screen-filling decision.

nodes.label: graphify-out/ Artifacts (graph.json, wiki, GRAPH_REPORT.md)
nodes.rationale: wiki/index.md is preferred for broad navigation over raw source browsing; GRAPH_REPORT.md is reserved for broad architecture review because it is large.

nodes.label: Verifikation (1345 Tests, tsc, eslint)
nodes.rationale: 1345 tests green, `tsc -p tsconfig.app.json` clean, eslint unchanged at 141 pre-existing findings (no new ones).

nodes.label: Sprachen beim Start (DE/EN only launch policy)
nodes.norm_label: sprachen beim start (de/en only launch policy)
nodes.rationale: The app launches only in German and English, so only `de` and `en` wording is written and proofread. The twelve other locale files stay complete because the i18n contract demands every key in every language, but their wording is explicitly not ship-ready and must not be presented as reviewed; a native speaker must read over a language before it launches.

nodes.label: Adjektive als Überschrift: Einfach – Genau – Gründlich
nodes.norm_label: adjektive als uberschrift: einfach – genau – grundlich
nodes.rationale: EN Simple – Precise – Thorough. The precise names read slowly; an adjective carries the eye faster, but sits above the name rather than replacing it, because 'Einfach' alone does not say what is recorded — and that is exactly what someone choosing their data model must know. In the summary the reverse holds: the name is shown, not the adjective. Rejected: leicht–mittel–schwer ('schwer' describes the burden on the user, not the gain, and reads as 'you probably can't manage this'; 'mittel' says nothing), grob–genau–exakt ('grob' devalues, genau/exakt are indistinguishable) and minimal–normal–maximal (sounds like a settings menu). The chosen three are positive or neutral, form a real gradation and describe the quality of the record, not the effort.

nodes.label: Bestand auf eigener Achse (inventory is an independent axis)
nodes.norm_label: bestand auf eigener achse (inventory is an independent axis)
nodes.rationale: Measurement precision and stock-keeping are orthogonal concerns; coupling them to the tracking level forced users into a level they did not need.

nodes.label: Kartentext: was die Stufe hinzufügt
nodes.rationale: Each card now says what it adds over the previous one and what that buys, answering the real question: why should I go deeper? Two lines per card were dropped — 'Nicht erforderlich: …' moved below the group as one sentence because it applies to the choice, not to a single level (same argument as 'can be changed later'), and 'Als Nächstes: …' went entirely, being a promise about the next screen one click before you see it. Six lines per card became four.

nodes.label: Die Tabelle ist die einzige Wahrheit (single source of truth)
nodes.norm_label: die tabelle ist die einzige wahrheit (single source of truth)
nodes.rationale: Duplicated rules (`level !== 'intake_only'`, `!== 'complete'`, a hard-wired step list) silently drift apart. Everything now derives from trackingDepth.ts: dosePlanCapabilities from `quantity`/`titration`, wizardSteps from `productStrength`, and stackInventory asks about the level at all no more. A test pins that dosePlanCapabilities matches the table and that `inventory` never migrates back into it.

nodes.label: Theme-feste Farben (var(--accent), slate-400)
nodes.rationale: Fixed colours broke the light theme: the subline on `text-sky-300/70` was washed out and now uses `text-slate-400` (quiet, because it explains the adjective rather than competing with it); the PK hint on fixed `text-sky-200` now uses `var(--accent)`, the app accent that knows both themes; the dimmed comparison entries on `white/5` were invisible on light ground (white at 5 % opacity does not exist on white) and now use slate-400 with alpha. The selected segment shares the make of the entry below it — soft accent fill, accent border, accent text — since a garish solid fill broke with the app's soft glow and failed to tie segment and entry together. Both themes were checked.

nodes.label: Offene Übersetzungen der zwölf Nicht-DE/EN-Sprachen
nodes.rationale: The third level's name and the changed sentences were rendered plausibly (Wirkstärke → concentración, dosage, dosaggio, дозировка, 함량, 规格 …) but are not native-speaker reviewed. They are still better than the previous state, which claimed in all twelve languages that inventory was only available on the highest level — which was simply false.
